from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, re, statistics, subprocess, sys

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('stem')
a = p.parse_args()
lab = Path('F:/Projects/tyrax2-lab-20261001')
source = lab / (a.stem + '.log')
snapshot = lab / (a.stem + '-snapshot.log')
assert not snapshot.exists(), 'Refusing to replace frozen evidence'
snapshot.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
flat = snapshot.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').replace('\r', '').replace('\n', '')
assert 'NIGHTISOLATE done first=15400' in flat, 'Run is not complete'
fixture = json.loads((lab / 'night-isolation/fixture.json').read_text())
results = []
for phase, name in enumerate(fixture['phases']):
    first = phase * 2200 + 1100
    work = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([
        sys.executable, 'F:/Projects/tyra-editor/tools/tyrax2-timing.py',
        str(snapshot), '--first', str(first), '--frames', '512', '--hz', '60'], text=True))
    periods = []
    for part in flat.split('LOG: FRAMETIME ')[1:]:
        record = part.split('LOG:')[0]
        f = re.search(r'\bf=(\d+)', record)
        period = re.search(r'\bperiod=([0-9.]+)', record)
        if f and period and first <= int(f[1]) < first + 500:
            row = {'frame': int(f[1]), 'period_ms': float(period[1])}
            for field in ['pre', 'stall', 'drain']:
                match = re.search(r'\b'+field+r'=([0-9.]+)', record)
                assert match, record
                row[field+'_ms'] = float(match[1])
            periods.append(row)
    assert [r['frame'] for r in periods] == list(range(first, first+500, 50)), periods
    work.update(phase=phase, name=name, period_windows=periods,
                mean_period_ms=statistics.mean(r['period_ms'] for r in periods))
    work['delivered_rate_from_period_hz'] = 1000 / work['mean_period_ms']
    work['mean_pre_ms'] = statistics.mean(r['pre_ms'] for r in periods)
    work['mean_stall_ms'] = statistics.mean(r['stall_ms'] for r in periods)
    results.append(work)
out = {'fixture': fixture, 'log': str(snapshot),
       'log_sha256': hashlib.sha256(snapshot.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
       'elf_sha256': hashlib.sha256((lab/(a.stem+'.elf')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
       'results': results,
       'note': 'Single physical boot, sequential one-group removals; full-night controls bracket the run. Work and neighboring period windows are different measurements.'}
(lab/(a.stem+'-summary.json')).write_bytes((json.dumps(out, indent=2)+'\n').encode())
for r in results:
    print(f"{r['phase']} {r['name']}: work {r['mean_ms']:.3f} ms, p95 {r['p95_ms']:.3f}, period {r['mean_period_ms']:.3f} ms, {r['delivered_rate_from_period_hz']:.2f} Hz")

from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, sys

tool = 'F:/Projects/tyra-editor/tools/tyrax2-timing.py'
lab = Path('F:/Projects/tyrax2-lab-20261001')
fixture = lab/'timing-record-boundary-control.log'
def check(raw, ok):
    fixture.write_bytes(raw.encode())
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, tool, str(fixture), '--first', '0', '--frames', '64', '--hz', '60'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert (r.returncode == 0) == ok, r.stderr
    if ok:
        d = json.loads(r.stdout)
        assert d['mean_ms'] == 1.0 and d['frames'] == 64, d
row = 'LOG: FTRAW 0 ' + ' '.join(['48000']*64)
check(row+'\nLOG: other\n', True)
for marker in ['FRAMEARENA', 'NATIVEVIF', 'ORDEREDFRAME', 'FRAMEPIPELINE', 'NIGHTISOLATE']:
    check(row+marker+' frames=120\n', True)
check(row.replace('48000', '48\n000', 1)+'FRAMEARENA frames=120\n', True)
check('LOG: FTRAW 0 '+' '.join(['48000']*63)+'FRAMEARENA frames=120\n', False)
check(row+' 48000FRAMEARENA frames=120\n', False)
check(row+'UNKNOWN frames=120\n', False)
check(row+'\n'+row, False)
baseline = lab/'pipeline-gif-send-night-boot2-snapshot-summary.json'
expected = json.loads(baseline.read_text())
r = subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, tool, expected['log'], '--first', '1100', '--frames', '512', '--hz', '60'], text=True)
actual = json.loads(r)
for field in ['mean_ms', 'median_ms', 'p95_ms', 'max_ms', 'over_budget']:
    assert actual[field] == expected[field], (field, actual[field], expected[field])
print('11 boundary/strictness controls passed; archived 512-frame night baseline unchanged')
